HexKagune 1.0.11 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server; everyone on a server needs this jar.

**The Dragon comes out of you**
- **A nine-second cutscene before the Dragon.** When Kaneki dies with the Dragon armed, he doesn't erupt at once any more. He stands where he fell and the camera cuts to him, close, from in front. He clutches his chest. Then he screams as kagune tears out of it, and screams again as more tears out of his head, clawing at it. Black centipede plates spread over him from the wound, with red cracks running ahead of them, a half mask grows over one side of his face, and a segmented tail rips out of his lower back. His heart pounds faster and faster. Violent bursts of blood and darkness throw everything near him off its feet. Then he bursts open and the Dragon erupts.
- **Fully immortal the whole time.** You can't be hurt and your keys don't move you.

**The camera, fixed**
- **No more blacked-out view.** The screen sometimes turned into a wall of blocks during the Dragon. That came from Minecraft painting the block around the player's own head over the whole screen: your body is held in the ground under the Dragon while the camera is far away. That overlay is now switched off while the Dragon's camera has the view.
- **Smarter shots.** The camera now looks for a clear view around or above whatever blocks it (hills, the Dragon's own coils) and moves there quickly, instead of staying stuck behind a hill.

**Also**
- **The Dragon is only for Kaneki DNA.** No other path can start it, not even through the admin trigger, and only Kaneki gets the final kakuja.
- **The choice cards match the kagune menu.** Same organic board, veins and lettering. Hold the bar to choose, and you transform right away.
- **War's eye sits on your kakugan.** It goes exactly where you placed your kakugan in the kakugan screen. If your kakugan is your right eye, the whole mask is mirrored.
- **New command:** `/kagune quest complete all` finishes every quest you have on right now: open journal quests, tonight's hunts and favours. `/kagune quest complete <id>` still finishes one.

The cutscene's body, pose and kagune, the War eye placement and the cards were checked in renders made with the game's own model, pose and drawing code. The cutscene's sounds, bursts and camera, and the new command, compile and pass the build's checks but haven't been tried in game yet. The build passes the full verifier and the dedicated-server check.
